# Purpose

This Rmd summarizes WES mutation frequency and tumor VAF for selected genes in the **10 ER+ pILC Bionano/OGM subgroup**.

Genes summarized:

```{r genes-listed}
vaf_genes <- c("CDH1", "PIK3CA", "ERBB2", "ERBB3")
print(vaf_genes)
```

Tumor VAF is calculated from the WES MAF count columns as:

```text
Tumor VAF (%) = 100 * t_alt_count / t_depth
```

If `t_depth` is missing but `t_ref_count` and `t_alt_count` are present, the script also calculates a backup VAF:

```text
Tumor VAF (%) = 100 * t_alt_count / (t_ref_count + t_alt_count)
```

# 2. Helper functions

```{r helper-functions}
clean_sample <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)

  # MAF IDs may be TP05-232_T, TP05-232_Tumor, TP05-232-T, or TP05-232.T
  x <- sub("_Tumor$", "", x)
  x <- sub("_T$", "", x)
  x <- sub("-T$", "", x)
  x <- sub("\\.T$", "", x)

  x
}

make_numeric_safely <- function(x) {
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(x)))
}

write_empty_table <- function(dt, file) {
  fwrite(dt, file = file, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = "")
  cat("Saved empty table:\n  ", file, "\n")
}
```

# 3. Read original combined MAF

```{r read-maf}
if (!file.exists(combined_maf_file)) {
  stop("Combined MAF file does not exist: ", combined_maf_file)
}

combined_maf <- fread(
  combined_maf_file,
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE,
  data.table = TRUE,
  fill = TRUE,
  quote = "",
  na.strings = c("", "NA", "NaN", "N/A", ".")
)

cat("Combined MAF dimensions:\n")
print(dim(combined_maf))

required_cols <- c(
  "Tumor_Sample_Barcode",
  "Hugo_Symbol",
  "Variant_Classification",
  "t_depth",
  "t_ref_count",
  "t_alt_count"
)

missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, colnames(combined_maf))

if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop("Missing required columns in combined MAF: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
}

combined_maf[, Tumor_Sample_Barcode := trimws(as.character(Tumor_Sample_Barcode))]
combined_maf[, Hugo_Symbol := trimws(as.character(Hugo_Symbol))]
combined_maf[, Variant_Classification := trimws(as.character(Variant_Classification))]
combined_maf[, Sample_clean := clean_sample(Tumor_Sample_Barcode)]

cat("\nFirst few cleaned sample IDs:\n")
print(head(unique(combined_maf$Sample_clean), 20))
```

# 4. Subset to ER+ Bionano subgroup and define WES availability

```{r subset-grant-samples}
# Protein-altering / non-synonymous classes used for WES mutation summary.
nonsyn_classes <- c(
  "Missense_Mutation",
  "Nonsense_Mutation",
  "Frame_Shift_Del",
  "Frame_Shift_Ins",
  "In_Frame_Del",
  "In_Frame_Ins",
  "Splice_Site",
  "Translation_Start_Site",
  "Nonstop_Mutation",
  "Start_Codon_Del",
  "Start_Codon_Ins",
  "Stop_Codon_Del",
  "Stop_Codon_Ins"
)

combined_maf_grant_all <- combined_maf[
  Sample_clean %in% grant_samples_10
]

combined_maf_grant <- combined_maf_grant_all[
  Variant_Classification %in% nonsyn_classes
]

# Use clean sample names downstream.
combined_maf_grant_all[, Tumor_Sample_Barcode := Sample_clean]
combined_maf_grant[, Tumor_Sample_Barcode := Sample_clean]

# WES-available samples are samples present in the original combined MAF.
# This captures WES availability independent of whether the selected genes are mutated.
wes_samples_available <- grant_samples_10[
  grant_samples_10 %in% unique(combined_maf_grant_all$Tumor_Sample_Barcode)
]

wes_sample_check <- data.table(
  Sample = grant_samples_10,
  Present_in_original_combined_MAF = grant_samples_10 %in% unique(combined_maf_grant_all$Tumor_Sample_Barcode),
  Has_non_synonymous_WES_call_any_gene = grant_samples_10 %in% unique(combined_maf_grant$Tumor_Sample_Barcode)
)

cat("\n========== WES availability among 10 ER+ Bionano samples ==========\n")
print(wes_sample_check)

cat("\nWES-available samples:\n")
print(wes_samples_available)
cat("Number of WES-available samples:", length(wes_samples_available), "\n\n")

fwrite(
  wes_sample_check,
  file = file.path(table_dir, "ERpos_Bionano_n10_WES_sample_availability_from_original_combined_MAF.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  na = ""
)
```

# 5. Diagnostic check of WES VAF columns

```{r vaf-column-diagnostic}
vaf_check_dt <- combined_maf_grant[
  Hugo_Symbol %in% vaf_genes,
  .(
    Tumor_Sample_Barcode,
    Hugo_Symbol,
    Variant_Classification,
    t_depth,
    t_ref_count,
    t_alt_count,
    HGVSp_Short = if ("HGVSp_Short" %in% colnames(combined_maf_grant)) HGVSp_Short else NA_character_,
    Source_MAF_File = if ("Source_MAF_File" %in% colnames(combined_maf_grant)) Source_MAF_File else NA_character_
  )
]

cat("\n========== Raw WES VAF-related columns for selected genes ==========\n")
print(vaf_check_dt)

vaf_missingness <- vaf_check_dt[
  ,
  .(
    n_rows = .N,
    t_depth_nonmissing = sum(!is.na(t_depth) & as.character(t_depth) != ""),
    t_ref_count_nonmissing = sum(!is.na(t_ref_count) & as.character(t_ref_count) != ""),
    t_alt_count_nonmissing = sum(!is.na(t_alt_count) & as.character(t_alt_count) != "")
  )
]

cat("\n========== Missingness of WES VAF columns ==========\n")
print(vaf_missingness)

fwrite(
  vaf_check_dt,
  file = file.path(table_dir, "ERpos_Bionano_WES_CDH1_PIK3CA_ERBB2_ERBB3_raw_VAF_column_check.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

fwrite(
  vaf_missingness,
  file = file.path(table_dir, "ERpos_Bionano_WES_CDH1_PIK3CA_ERBB2_ERBB3_VAF_column_missingness.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  na = ""
)
```

# 6. WES VAF calculation and summary tables

```{r wes-vaf-summary}
wes_vaf_genes <- copy(
  combined_maf_grant[
    Hugo_Symbol %in% vaf_genes
  ]
)

# Add optional columns if missing, so downstream table code is stable.
optional_cols <- c(
  "Chromosome",
  "Start_Position",
  "End_Position",
  "Reference_Allele",
  "Tumor_Seq_Allele2",
  "HGVSp_Short",
  "HGVSp",
  "HGVSc",
  "Source_MAF_File"
)

for (cc in optional_cols) {
  if (!cc %in% colnames(wes_vaf_genes)) {
    wes_vaf_genes[, (cc) := NA_character_]
  }
}

# Convert count columns to numeric.
wes_vaf_genes[, t_depth_num := make_numeric_safely(t_depth)]
wes_vaf_genes[, t_ref_count_num := make_numeric_safely(t_ref_count)]
wes_vaf_genes[, t_alt_count_num := make_numeric_safely(t_alt_count)]

# Primary VAF calculation: t_alt_count / t_depth.
wes_vaf_genes[, Tumor_VAF_percent := fifelse(
  !is.na(t_depth_num) & t_depth_num > 0 & !is.na(t_alt_count_num),
  100 * t_alt_count_num / t_depth_num,
  NA_real_
)]

wes_vaf_genes[, VAF_Source := fifelse(
  !is.na(Tumor_VAF_percent),
  "t_alt_count / t_depth",
  NA_character_
)]

# Backup VAF calculation: t_alt_count / (t_ref_count + t_alt_count)
# This is used only when t_depth-based VAF is not available.
wes_vaf_genes[
  is.na(Tumor_VAF_percent) &
    !is.na(t_ref_count_num) &
    !is.na(t_alt_count_num) &
    (t_ref_count_num + t_alt_count_num) > 0,
  `:=`(
    Tumor_VAF_percent = 100 * t_alt_count_num / (t_ref_count_num + t_alt_count_num),
    VAF_Source = "t_alt_count / (t_ref_count + t_alt_count)"
  )
]

cat("\n========== WES selected-gene rows with VAF calculation status ==========\n")
print(
  wes_vaf_genes[
    ,
    .(
      Tumor_Sample_Barcode,
      Hugo_Symbol,
      Variant_Classification,
      t_depth,
      t_ref_count,
      t_alt_count,
      Tumor_VAF_percent = round(Tumor_VAF_percent, 2),
      VAF_Source,
      HGVSp_Short,
      Source_MAF_File
    )
  ][order(Hugo_Symbol, Tumor_Sample_Barcode, -Tumor_VAF_percent)]
)

# Keep all mutation rows for mutation-frequency summary.
# For VAF summaries, VAF values may be NA if count columns are empty.

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Variant-level WES VAF table
# ------------------------------------------------------------

variant_vaf_table <- wes_vaf_genes[
  ,
  .(
    Sample = Tumor_Sample_Barcode,
    Gene = Hugo_Symbol,
    Variant_Classification,
    Chromosome,
    Start_Position,
    End_Position,
    Reference_Allele,
    Tumor_Seq_Allele2,
    HGVSp_Short,
    HGVSp,
    HGVSc,
    t_depth = t_depth_num,
    t_ref_count = t_ref_count_num,
    t_alt_count = t_alt_count_num,
    Tumor_VAF_percent = round(Tumor_VAF_percent, 2),
    VAF_Source,
    Source_MAF_File
  )
][order(Gene, Sample, -Tumor_VAF_percent)]

cat("\n========== Variant-level WES VAF table ==========\n")
print(variant_vaf_table)

fwrite(
  variant_vaf_table,
  file = file.path(table_dir, "ERpos_Bionano_WES_CDH1_PIK3CA_ERBB2_ERBB3_variant_level_VAF.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Sample-gene WES summary
# One row per sample/gene. If multiple variants are present,
# keep max VAF for comparison but list all VAFs.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

sample_gene_vaf_summary <- wes_vaf_genes[
  ,
  .(
    n_variants = .N,
    max_VAF_percent = if (all(is.na(Tumor_VAF_percent))) NA_real_ else round(max(Tumor_VAF_percent, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    median_VAF_percent = if (all(is.na(Tumor_VAF_percent))) NA_real_ else round(median(Tumor_VAF_percent, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    VAF_percent_list = if (all(is.na(Tumor_VAF_percent))) NA_character_ else paste(round(Tumor_VAF_percent[!is.na(Tumor_VAF_percent)], 2), collapse = "; "),
    Variant_Classification_List = paste(unique(Variant_Classification), collapse = "; "),
    HGVSp_Short_List = paste(unique(na.omit(HGVSp_Short)), collapse = "; "),
    VAF_Source_List = paste(unique(na.omit(VAF_Source)), collapse = "; ")
  ),
  by = .(
    Sample = Tumor_Sample_Barcode,
    Gene = Hugo_Symbol
  )
][order(Gene, Sample)]

cat("\n========== Sample-gene WES VAF summary ==========\n")
print(sample_gene_vaf_summary)

fwrite(
  sample_gene_vaf_summary,
  file = file.path(table_dir, "ERpos_Bionano_WES_CDH1_PIK3CA_ERBB2_ERBB3_sample_gene_VAF_summary.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Gene-level WES summary
# Uses one value per sample/gene = max VAF.
# Mutation frequency does not require VAF to be calculable.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

gene_level_vaf_summary <- sample_gene_vaf_summary[
  ,
  .(
    mutated_samples = uniqueN(Sample),
    median_VAF_percent = if (all(is.na(max_VAF_percent))) NA_real_ else round(median(max_VAF_percent, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    mean_VAF_percent = if (all(is.na(max_VAF_percent))) NA_real_ else round(mean(max_VAF_percent, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    min_VAF_percent = if (all(is.na(max_VAF_percent))) NA_real_ else round(min(max_VAF_percent, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    max_VAF_percent = if (all(is.na(max_VAF_percent))) NA_real_ else round(max(max_VAF_percent, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
  ),
  by = Gene
]

gene_level_vaf_summary <- merge(
  data.table(Gene = vaf_genes),
  gene_level_vaf_summary,
  by = "Gene",
  all.x = TRUE,
  sort = FALSE
)

gene_level_vaf_summary[is.na(mutated_samples), `:=`(
  mutated_samples = 0,
  median_VAF_percent = NA_real_,
  mean_VAF_percent = NA_real_,
  min_VAF_percent = NA_real_,
  max_VAF_percent = NA_real_
)]

gene_level_vaf_summary[, WES_assessable_samples := length(wes_samples_available)]

gene_level_vaf_summary[, mutation_frequency_percent := round(
  100 * mutated_samples / WES_assessable_samples,
  1
)]

setcolorder(
  gene_level_vaf_summary,
  c(
    "Gene",
    "mutated_samples",
    "WES_assessable_samples",
    "mutation_frequency_percent",
    "median_VAF_percent",
    "mean_VAF_percent",
    "min_VAF_percent",
    "max_VAF_percent"
  )
)

cat("\n========== Gene-level WES VAF summary ==========\n")
print(gene_level_vaf_summary)

fwrite(
  gene_level_vaf_summary,
  file = file.path(table_dir, "ERpos_Bionano_WES_CDH1_PIK3CA_ERBB2_ERBB3_gene_level_VAF_summary.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  na = ""
)
```

# 7. Complete sample x gene WES table

```{r complete-sample-gene-table}
sample_gene_complete <- CJ(
  Sample = grant_samples_10,
  Gene = vaf_genes
)

sample_gene_complete <- merge(
  sample_gene_complete,
  sample_gene_vaf_summary,
  by = c("Sample", "Gene"),
  all.x = TRUE,
  sort = FALSE
)

sample_gene_complete[, WES_available := Sample %in% wes_samples_available]

sample_gene_complete[, Mutation_status := fifelse(
  !WES_available,
  "WES not available",
  fifelse(is.na(n_variants), "No mutation detected", "Mutated")
)]

sample_gene_complete[is.na(n_variants), n_variants := 0]

sample_gene_complete <- sample_gene_complete[
  ,
  .(
    Sample,
    Gene,
    WES_available,
    Mutation_status,
    n_variants,
    max_VAF_percent,
    median_VAF_percent,
    VAF_percent_list,
    Variant_Classification_List,
    HGVSp_Short_List,
    VAF_Source_List
  )
][order(Sample, Gene)]

cat("\n========== Complete sample x gene WES VAF table ==========\n")
print(sample_gene_complete)

fwrite(
  sample_gene_complete,
  file = file.path(table_dir, "ERpos_Bionano_WES_CDH1_PIK3CA_ERBB2_ERBB3_complete_sample_gene_VAF_table.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

# Wide table for quick visual inspection.
sample_gene_complete[, VAF_display := fifelse(
  Mutation_status == "WES not available",
  "WES not available",
  fifelse(
    Mutation_status == "No mutation detected",
    "No mutation",
    fifelse(
      is.na(VAF_percent_list) | VAF_percent_list == "",
      "Mutated; VAF unavailable",
      paste0(VAF_percent_list, "%")
    )
  )
)]

wes_vaf_wide_table <- dcast(
  sample_gene_complete,
  Sample + WES_available ~ Gene,
  value.var = "VAF_display"
)

cat("\n========== WES VAF wide table ==========\n")
print(wes_vaf_wide_table)

fwrite(
  wes_vaf_wide_table,
  file = file.path(table_dir, "ERpos_Bionano_WES_CDH1_PIK3CA_ERBB2_ERBB3_wide_VAF_table.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  na = ""
)
```
